title: HistoricalCandidate — retrospective candidate profile (proposed under TDR-0048)
description: Schema for a historical candidate, per specification/historical-candidate.md. A profile over the existing interchange structures, carried unchanged, with the retrospective facts they cannot carry added beside them and keyed by identifier. Its standing is `none` and its status `candidate`, as constants: a historical candidate never acquires standing because someone, or something, reconstructed it. Closed, so a disposition, a forward link to a record, a rationale or a score is refused rather than discouraged. Contemporaneity is computed from the times, never stored. Sibling schemas are referenced by $id: load schemas/shared/ as a registry. Integrity rules a schema cannot express are part of the contract and listed in the specification.

contract_version.description: Version of THIS contract, independent of any record specification.

retrospective.description: Assembled after the event, from what survived it.

standing.description: Always `none`. Standing is conferred by a named individual's act, recorded beside the candidate in a review event, never in it.

status.description: Always `candidate`. There is no other legal value.

event_time_ref.description: The contribution_id of the contribution to the package's event role, or `unknown`. A pointer, never a copy.

fragment_annotations.description: Exactly one per fragment (an integrity rule).

capture_time.description: When the content was recorded. YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD at the precision the evidence gives, never completed; or `unknown`.

creation_time.description: When the artefact holding the content was produced. YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD at the precision the evidence gives, never completed; or `unknown`.

restates.description: The source this fragment repeats. Independence counts once.

contribution_annotations.description: One per contribution to a role the package designates as context.

considered.description: Was the material available to, or considered by, whoever acted? Pre-dating shows it existed, not that it was read.

fragment_refs.description: The fragments showing the link. Required for `evidenced`, empty otherwise.
